target: Percent of 15 one-minute closes in [09:30,09:45) strictly above observed 09:30 minute open. Exact target requires all 15 candles; unknown labels remain in scoring cohort.
auxiliary_target: Percent of 15 minute lows strictly above opening price; saved only, not optimized.
opportunity_set: Rebuild market-wide historical CS/ADRC securities, not the earlier first15-turnover-selected cohort. At cutoff, require PM gap >=10%, PM RVOL >=5 against previous10 same-cutoff sessions, ten matched historical identities, and same-identity prior regular-session grid with every minute (including early closes).

timing.primary: delayed_0914: bars starting before 09:14, completed by 09:14. A 15-minute delay leaves about one minute before the 09:30 research entry.
timing.secondary: realtime_0929: bars starting before 09:29. Requires timely real-time data; not deployable at the open on the current delayed feed.

execution_caveat: 09:30 minute open is a historical reference, not a guaranteed broker/auction fill. No actual receipt-time or broker-deadline reconstruction is claimed.
features: Pre-cutoff PM and last30/15/5 price/volume/transaction/volatility/VWAP/shape features; optional prior-session and prior-ten-session statistics including past opening occupancy, and pre-cutoff SPY/QQQ-relative returns. No current opening price, volume, price action or candle completeness in features or eligibility.
split: Reuse original train/validation/test calendar splits and two embargo dates, without recomputing boundaries after filtering. Test dates were viewed previously.
selection: Fit training only. Primary forecast chooses minimum validation RMSE to target numerical percentage prediction; MAE also reported. Separate precision companion chooses maximum validation top20% Wilson lower bound for >=80% occupancy, with RMSE tie-break. No refit after selection.
precision_policy: High occupancy means >=12/15 closes above entry. Validation cutoff needs >=80% conservative precision, >=25 calls over >=10 dates, Wilson lower >=65%; otherwise disclose research fallback. Unknown selected targets count against precision. Predicted occupancy is not a class probability.
reporting: Report all eligible and exact-label counts, MAE/RMSE/R2/Spearman, calibration, fraction within one candle, and top5/10/20 precision/counts/unknowns. Timing cohorts can differ; include a common-cohort diagnostic. No profit is inferred from occupancy alone. Existing paper strategy unchanged.
